Contract: reject interior start offset (splitPair(offset)), move interior end backward, reject nonempty read without progress... "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair" — current code: end adjusted back; if end-1==offset and offset interior? need end>offset. Also need reject interior start. Current code checks need(end>offset||offset===text.length) but not interior start. Add check. Also "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress" — if end after moving back equals offset (i.e., max 1 char but split pair)? current handles. Also move interior end backward — done. Interior start reject: need(!splitPair(offset),...). Also empty slice exactly at EOF allowed — offset===text.length returns empty, ok.

Write patch with added start check.
